flags.message: The petitioners' reply brief (docketed Sep 30 2026, before the 2026-10-08 snapshot) was not among the provisioned documents under record/documents/ (petition, BIO, QP only). In forward mode I fetched it from supremecourt.gov myself and used it; other predictors in this fan-out that did not will have reasoned from a thinner common baseline. Consider adding the cert-stage reply to the document pipeline where one is on the docket before the snapshot.
